'''XR-9 Scrambler Grenade''' was a model of [[Ion grenade/Legends|ion grenade]] used by the [[Eternal Empire]] personnel stationed on the [[Star Fortress]]es.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
XR-9 Scrambler Grenades appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during [[Star Fortress]] missions and also as housing decorations.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' {{1st}}
